The additional hearts are lost as you take damage.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Drinking Hearty Elixirs will restore all of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s, in addition to granting him [[Extra Hearts]]. As Link takes damage, these Extra Hearts are lost. Hearty Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Hearty Lizard]]s By adding any of these hearty [[Ingredient]]s, Link can increase the number of temporary Hearts he receives: * [[Hearty Bass]] * [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s * [[Hearty Durian]]s * [[Hearty Radish]]es * [[Big Hearty Radish]]es * [[Hearty Salmon]]s * [[Hearty Truffle]]s * [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Hearty Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]] or [[Portable Pot]]: * [[Hearty Lizard]]s By adding any of these hearty [[Ingredient]]s, Link can increase the number of [[Extra Heart]]s he receives: * [[Hearty Bass]] * [[Hearty Radish]]es * [[Big Hearty Radish]]es * [[Hearty Salmon]]s * [[Hearty Truffle]]s * [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
